dwelling_habits.dwelling: Shallow Aruba reef crests and flats — blade-like yellow-tan colonies in surge.
dwelling_habits.food: Symbiotic algae plus plankton stung by tiny polyps.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Looks like coral but is a hydrozoan relative of jellyfish.
dwelling_habits.mating: Releases medusae; also spreads by colony growth.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Forms nursery structure for juvenile reef fish on Aruba’s leeward shallows.

fun_facts: Touching it feels like a bee sting — admire with eyes, not fingers.
Common on Aruba’s shallow reef islands alongside elkhorn stands.
